_meta.what: Per-axis composer portfolio specs. Each axis declares SLOTS by source class, not a source list — diversification is the rule, filling is autonomous (data_scout candidates + human promotion via composer.py --promote, which edits this file as a reviewable git diff).

classes.anchor_annual: slow official anchor (the scientific ground truth)
classes.measurement_daily: daily-moving direct measurement of the same quantity
classes.indirect_proxy: related quantity that constrains/confirms the anchor

_meta.template_axis: CLIMATE_GLOBAL_RISK_REVIEW — first composer; prove it, then replicate per axis
_meta.cadence_note: Every source carries a 'cadence' (6 Sep 2026). core.cadence.load_specs refuses to load this file if any source lacks one: a source without a declared cadence must fail loud and by name, never inherit 'daily'.

sources.provenance: NASA EONET v3 wildfire event count, 7d window. Event COUNT, not burned area; EONET coverage is uneven by region. Honest proxy for climate-driven hazard activity.

UN SDG SH_H2O_SAFE, World (M49 areaCode=1). SDG 6.1.1, WHO/UNICEF JMP. Exact match for this axis's declared primary_metric safe_water_access_pct (target 100). Replaces gi_safe_water_access_pct, whose snapshot key has been None.
USGS NWIS gauge 01646500, real instrument observation. SINGLE US river — a local measurement standing in for a global water slot. Directionally honest, geographically narrow.
NASA EONET v3 flood event count, 30d window (status=all — the open-only filter returns 0). Event COUNT, not severity or people affected.

UN SDG ER_H2O_STRESS, World (M49 areaCode=1). SDG 6.4.2 water stress. A DIFFERENT quantity from access, so it constrains rather than duplicates. The slot previously held gi_undernourishment_pct — a FOOD indicator mis-filed under water, and null besides.

UN SDG AG_PRD_FIESMS, World (M49 areaCode=1). SDG 2.1.2, FAO. Exact match for the declared primary_metric food_insecurity_pct (target 2.5). Replaces gi_undernourishment_pct, which is None in the snapshot.

Open-Meteo (ECMWF-derived) reference evapotranspiration at 41.9N/-93.6W. A crop WATER-DEMAND proxy over one growing region — not a food-supply measurement, not global. Weakest link in the FOOD portfolio.

NASA EONET v3 severe-storm count. NOT food-specific: EONET's drought category is permanently empty, so this stands in as a crop-disruption proxy shared with ENERGY. Replace when a real food-event feed is found.

Open-Meteo solar resource at 51.2N/10.4E. The DRIVER of solar generation, not generation itself, and one country only. Stand-in until a keyless generation feed is found (ENTSO-E and EIA both require API keys).
NASA EONET v3 severe-storm count as a grid-disruption proxy. NOT energy-specific — EONET has no energy category. Shared with FOOD; replace when a real outage/generation feed is found.
UNHCR refugee stock. NOTE: target_config states the metric in PERSONS, this is MILLIONS — a scale difference the scorer must reconcile, not the composer.

UCDP/PRIO ACD via the cycle's global_indicators snapshot. ANNUAL cadence, correct for anchor_annual and wrong for any daily slot. Reads 65 for 2025 once the snapshot refreshes at fast_cycle step 2.5; the file on disk still holds the pre-fix 2816 until that run.

Population-weighted WGI+V-Dem composite, the declared primary_metric.
US 10-year Treasury constant-maturity yield, daily, no API key. A FINANCIAL-CONDITIONS proxy for one country — not global economic activity. Directionally informative, narrow.
ECB daily USD/EUR reference rate. Reserve source for the slot; an FX rate is a weak economic proxy, kept for org diversity and liveness.
INFANT mortality. The axis's primary_metric is UNDER-5 (child) mortality — related but not identical; the real under-5 series is still missing.

UN SDG SH_DYN_MORT, World (M49 areaCode=1). SDG 3.2.1 under-five mortality, UN IGME. Exact match for the declared primary_metric child_mortality_per_1000. Age <5Y is the INDICATOR'S DEFINITION, not a breakdown. Replaces gi_infant_mortality, None in the snapshot.

UN SDG IT_USE_ii99, World (M49 areaCode=1). SDG 17.8.1 individuals using the internet, ITU. The standard headline measure of information infrastructure reach. Replaces gi_broadband, None in the snapshot.
Poverty headcount at the $1.90/day line. target_config specifies the $2.15 line — same concept, different threshold; not interchangeable without restating.
UN SDG SP_TRN_PUBL, World (M49 areaCode=1). SDG 11.2.1 convenient access to public transport. An infrastructure measure for an infrastructure axis. Replaces gi_urban_pct, None in the snapshot.
ADULT literacy. The axis's primary_metric is YOUTH literacy — the youth series is not in the snapshot, so this stands in and the gap stays named.

UN SDG VC_VAW_MTUHRA, World (M49 areaCode=1). SDG 16.10.1 killings of journalists, human rights defenders and trade unionists. A DIRECT press-freedom measure, and this axis had ZERO sources in every slot. Higher is worse — the scorer must be told, this composer does not orient.
UN SDG AG_LND_FRST, World (M49 areaCode=1). SDG 15.1.1 forest area. Exact match for the declared primary_metric forest_area_pct (target 35). Replaces gi_forest_area, None in the snapshot.
NASA EONET sea/lake-ice event count, 30d. Cryosphere habitat change; an event COUNT, not extent or severity.
CO2 as the axis's declared proxy for material throughput (target_config sets primary_metric=co2_ppm_mauna_loa for this axis).

NOAA GML global daily CO2 trend, column 3 (smoothed) to MATCH the column CLIMATE already reads — two axes declaring the same primary metric must not report different numbers. NOTE: col 4 is the de-seasonalised trend; which column belongs in a daily slot is an open question for review, not settled here.
self-discovered, human-promoted

UN SDG ER_PTD_FRHWTR, World (M49 areaCode=1). SDG 15.1.2 freshwater KBA protection. DELIBERATELY indirect_proxy and NOT the anchor: this axis's declared primary_metric is protected_TERRESTRIAL_area_pct (target 30) and the terrestrial series ER_PTD_TERRS has no world row. Filling the anchor with a freshwater figure would hand the scorer a number to compare against a target meant for a different biome.
USGS global earthquake count, rolling 24h, no key. Geophysical hazard activity — a COUNT at all magnitudes, so it moves with detection coverage as well as with real seismicity.
Known-worlds count as the crudest possible frontier indicator. Not a resource measure; placeholder until a real one is found.
